operations.description: In the NSIDC Search and Arctic Data Explorer interfaces, this endpoint is used in conjunction with /OpenSearch whenever a user submits a new search. Consequently, it has the same parameters as /OpenSearch.
operations.summary: View the facet information corresponding to a search
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] facets [PATH] facets [PARAMS] count date end facet filters index keys search sort source spatial start terms [SCHEMA]

operations.description: This endpoint uses parameters from the OpenSearch 1.1 specification, as well as parameters from the OpenSearch Geo (1.0) and SRU (1.0) extensions.
operations.summary: Search documents using the OpenSearch 1.1 Specification
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] open search [PATH] open search [PARAMS] count date end facet filters index keys search sort source spatial start terms [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: Describes the web interface of NSIDC's data search engine
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] opensearch description [PATH] open search description [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: In NSIDC Search and the Arctic Data Explorer, this endpoint is queried whenever the user types into the search terms box, and the returned suggestions are displayed in a dropdown beneath the search terms box. The q parameter and returned JSON follow the specifications of the OpenSearch Suggestions 1.0 extension.
operations.summary: Suggest search terms based on a partial query
